::: {.lead-text}
Since 2021, I have taught more than 500 hours at INSA Toulouse, from
first-year mathematics to graduate courses in model reduction. I like to
connect theory and computation: most of my courses pair mathematical
concepts with hands-on Python sessions, so that students see the methods at
work on concrete engineering problems.
:::

## Student supervision

::: {.project-card}
[Internship · 3 months]{.status .status-submitted}

### Hydrodynamic model reduction for real-time simulation of floodplain dynamics

Supervision of a fifth-year engineering student at INSA Toulouse (2022)
during a three-month research internship on reduced-order models of the
shallow-water equations, with the goal of simulating floodplain dynamics in
real time.

*Original title: Réductions de modèle d'hydrodynamique pour simuler en temps
réel la dynamique de plaines d'inondations.*
:::

::: {.project-card}
[Internship · 4 months]{.status .status-submitted}

### Model reduction of PDEs: hybrid POD–NN versus Gaussian process regression

Supervision of a fourth-year engineering student at INSA Toulouse (2024)
during a four-month research internship comparing two non-intrusive
reduction approaches for PDE models: the hybrid POD–neural network method
and Gaussian process regression.

*Original title: Comparaison de la réduction de modèles EDP par la méthode
hybride POD-NN et la méthode des processus gaussiens.*
:::
